decisions.title: Single source of truth for the profiles root
decisions.outcome: src/config/browser_profiles.py owns DEFAULT_BROWSER_PROFILES_DIR, browser_profiles_dir(), excluded_roots() and EXCLUDED_PATH_PATTERNS; settings.browser_profiles_dir (BROWSER_PROFILES_DIR) configures it

decisions.title: Two independent exclusion checks
decisions.outcome: component pattern .aca/browser-profiles catches the default layout for any user; resolved configured root catches unusual locations and symlinks

decisions.title: Only two copy paths exist
decisions.outcome: artifacts tar and FileSyncer; pg_dump, graph dumps, bao snapshot and sync export/import carry no local files

deviations.reason: aca-backup runs as a different user so ~ resolves elsewhere

deviations.from_plan: harden the systemd unit with ProtectHome
deviations.reason: would silently drop artifact paths under /home

recommendations: ri-08: create per-site profiles as browser_profiles_dir()/site with mode 0700 and import from src.config.browser_profiles
tar exclusion flags are GNU-only; gx-10 has GNU tar 1.35

decisions.title: SecretSink protocol with three sinks
decisions.outcome: src/cli/secret_sinks.py: RailwaySink, BaoSink, SecretsFileSink; write(mapping) returns key names and never echoes values; aca auth gmail|youtube --to railway|bao|secrets-file, --deploy is a deprecated alias

decisions.title: Server-side KV v2 PATCH instead of hvac kv.v2.patch()
decisions.outcome: hvac 2.4.0 patch() is read_secret_version + create_or_update_secret(cas); BaoSink sends PATCH /v1/<mount>/data/<path> with application/merge-patch+json via client.adapter.request, needing only the patch capability

decisions.title: saved_at as sibling keys
decisions.outcome: BaoSink writes <KEY>_SAVED_AT in the same atomic PATCH; saved_at_key() lives in src/config/secrets.py

deviations.actual: sink never creates the path; 404 points at the seed script
deviations.reason: creation requires create_or_update, which the effort forbids

deviations.actual: host converted them back to # noqa codes
deviations.reason: CI pins ruff 0.15.15, which rejects ruff: ignore (RUF102); venv ruff 0.16.8 differs

recommendations: ri-04/ri-11: write X_AUTH_TOKEN and X_CT0 in one BaoSink.write() so the pair stays consistent; reuse the worker's authenticated hvac client
Server-side KV v2 PATCH needs OpenBao/Vault >= 1.9; not yet exercised against a live server
Lint with uvx ruff@0.15.15, never the venv ruff

decisions.title: Loopback binds behind tailscale serve
decisions.outcome: API (systemd aca-api.service, ACA_API_HOST=127.0.0.1) and OpenBao (deploy/gx10/docker-compose.gx10.yml, ${ACA_BAO_BIND_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:8200) listen on loopback; tailscale serve terminates Let's Encrypt TLS on the MagicDNS name

decisions.title: Configurable proxy trust
decisions.outcome: docker-entrypoint.sh reads ACA_API_HOST and ACA_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS with the old defaults, so Railway is unchanged and gx-10 trusts only 127.0.0.1 for X-Forwarded-For (the login rate limiter keys on it)

decisions.title: Workstation BAO_ADDR
decisions.outcome: https://gx-10.<tailnet>.ts.net:8200 via tailscale serve; no BAO_CACERT needed

deviations.actual: standalone deploy/gx10 compose file with a raft OpenBao server
deviations.reason: compose merges ports lists, so an override cannot remove the dev 0.0.0.0:8200 publish; dev overlay is also in-memory -dev mode

recommendations: ri-15: use optional_host_permissions plus chrome.permissions.request for the tailnet origin, then drop the interim chrome-extension:// ALLOWED_ORIGINS note
Nothing verified on a live tailnet; operator must run the Verify section of docs/TAILNET.md (task 4.4 open)
Follow-up outside this roadmap: a production/gx-10 profile and loopback binds for the data stores in the root docker-compose.yml
